label: Classify
depicts: Four round dots arranged in a two by two grid
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple four item classification grid made from dots.
avoid_when: Do not use for square or petal grids when the four round dots are the visible cue.

label: Classify
depicts: Four tile grid with three square panels and one top right diamond panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classification grid made from square tiles with one diamond tile.
avoid_when: Do not use for dot or petal grids when the square and diamond tile mix matters.

label: Classify
depicts: Four petal tiles arranged around the center like a clover grid
use_when: Use when the interface wants a softer rounded classification grid built from petal like tiles.
avoid_when: Do not use for dot or square tile grids when the petal shapes are the key cue.

label: Columns
depicts: Rectangle frame split into two tall vertical column panels
use_when: Use when the interface wants a framed two column layout instead of a classify grid.
avoid_when: Do not use for free standing bars when the outer rectangle frame should remain visible.

label: Columns
depicts: Two separate tall column bars standing apart with no outer frame
use_when: Use when the interface wants two free standing column bars instead of a framed split rectangle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the framed column icon when the outer container should be absent.
